crossRefs.note: So the ship master came to him, and said to him, “What do you mean, sleeper? Arise, call on your God! Maybe your God…
He said, “While the child was yet alive, I fasted and wept; for I said, ‘Who knows whether Yahweh will not be gracious…
He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
Tear your heart, and not your garments, and turn to Yahweh, your God; for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger…
Who knows? He may turn and relent, and leave a blessing behind him, even a meal offering and a drink offering to…
Hate evil, love good, and establish justice in the courts. It may be that Yahweh, the God of Armies, will be gracious…
I will get up and go to my father, and will tell him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in your sight.

translations.web: Who knows whether God will not turn and relent, and turn away from his fierce anger, so that we might not perish?”
translations.bsb: Who knows? God may turn and relent; He may turn from His fierce anger, so that we will not perish.”
translations.kjv: Who can tell if God will turn and repent, and turn away from his fierce anger, that we perish
translations.asv: Who knoweth whether God will not turn and repent, and turn away from his fierce anger, that we perish not?
